title: Zesty Indulgent Malaysian Dates Curry
description: A resinous, aerated curry bursting with sweet medjool dates and aromatic spices. It is both indulgent and Whole30-friendly.
instructions: Rinse and pit the dates, then chop into small pieces.
Dice onion, carrot, and celery into bite-size cubes.
Heat coconut oil in a pot over medium heat until hot.
Add diced onion, carrot, and celery to the pot and sauté for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in minced garlic, ginger, turmeric, and cumin, cooking for another 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in coconut milk and fish sauce, bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the chopped dates and lime juice, then simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and season with salt if needed.
Remove from heat and let the curry cool slightly.
Serve hot over a bed of steamed rice or enjoy on its own.
